name: ZStack
purpose: Overlap authored children in one depth-aware layout while preserving source, reading, and focus order.
useWhen: Two or more visual layers intentionally share the same region.

avoidWhen.condition: Content follows one row or column.
Content is an ordinary image-backed card or hero.

composition: Place natural-size layers directly in ZStack.Root and use ZStack.Item only when one layer needs its own nine-position alignment.

rules.statement: Keep DOM order meaningful because later children paint above earlier children.
Keep media before its overlay in source; ZStack preserves that order even when the media establishes a positioned layer.
Keep decorative layers from intercepting input intended for interactive content.
Use responsive logical alignment only to move the same authored layer; never change source order, depth order, or focus order at a breakpoint.
Load styles.css or core.css plus z-stack.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Replacing ordinary linear layout with overlap.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Stack or Grid unless layers intentionally share space.
Prefer Surface for standard media-backed content.

validation: Check natural sizing, responsive logical placement, focus order, zoom, RTL, and pointer access.
